description: A copy of masekhet ʿeruvin. Fol. 2r contains several ownership notes, including for its scribe (musaṭṭiruhā) Elʿazar b. Saʿadya b. Yosef; then Nadiv al-[...] b. Yosef; then Shelomo b. Avraham known as Dhahabī; then Shelomo b. Yeshuʿa b. Shelomo ha-Kohen. There is another illegible note at upper left.
